title: Device Authenticate - response  (server -> firmware)
description: System.Text.Json serialization of api.Models.DeviceAuthentication. Firmware reads payload["apiAuth"] in ServiceController::apiAuthenticate() and then sends it as the 'Authorization' header on subsequent /Config and /SensorData calls. On bad credentials the server returns 401 with no body (not covered by this schema).

apiAuth.description: Opaque session token (a GUID). The C# property is already named 'apiAuth' so camelCase serialization does not change it. In practice always a non-null fresh GUID; null is allowed here only because the C# type is string?.
